name: Liqwid Finance
description: Non-custodial algorithmic money market on Cardano using pooled, Compound-style lending. Suppliers earn interest and borrowers draw liquidity against posted collateral.
notes: Market list is reconstructed from Liqwid governance forum threads and secondary sources, not from a live snapshot of app.liqwid.finance — the live GraphQL markets query is the authoritative source. SHEN was onboarded then largely offboarded as collateral by governance vote and is excluded. No BTC market was confirmed.
